items.stem:
The following code has two errors. Rewrite the incorrect statements correctly:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
x = ['2021', '2022', '2023', '2024', '2025']
y = [110, 50, 51, 38, 69]
plt.plot(x, y, colour='red', label='Visitors (thousand)')
plt.title('Number')
plt.xlable('Year')
plt.ylabel('Visitors (thousand)')
plt.legend()
plt.show()
items.answer:
plt.xlable('Year')  →  plt.xlabel('Year')   (xlable() should be xlabel())
plt.plot(x, y, colour='red', label='Visitors (thousand)')  →  plt.plot(x, y, color='red', label='Visitors (thousand)')   (the keyword is color, not colour)
items.markingKey: 1 mark for each corrected statement.

items.stem:
The monthly rainfall (mm) of Mysuru is: Jun: 58, Jul: 171, Aug: 284, Sep: 137, Oct: 400.
Write a Python program using pyplot to plot Rainfall (mm) against Month as a black dash-dot line with plus markers; give the title "Monthly rainfall (mm) of Mysuru"; label both axes; and display the chart.
items.answer:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
x = ['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct']
y = [58, 171, 284, 137, 400]
plt.plot(x, y, color='black', linestyle='-.', marker='+')
plt.title('Monthly rainfall (mm) of Mysuru')
plt.xlabel('Month')
plt.ylabel('Rainfall (mm)')
plt.show()
items.markingKey: 3 marks: import and data ½–1, plot() with the required style 1, title/labels 1; any equivalent code (format string or keyword arguments) earns full marks.

items.stem: The maximum temperatures (°C) of Dehradun and Kochi from Monday to Friday are [31, 28, 39, 30, 38] and [36, 34, 31, 34, 44]. Write a program to plot both on the same chart: Dehradun as a blue line with downward triangle markers and Kochi as a yellow dashed line with square markers; add the title "Temperature Comparison", axis labels "Day" and "Temperature", a legend, and save the chart as temp.png.
items.answer:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
days = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri']
plt.plot(days, [31, 28, 39, 30, 38], color='blue', marker='v', label='Dehradun')
plt.plot(days, [36, 34, 31, 34, 44], color='yellow', linestyle='--', marker='s', label='Kochi')
plt.title('Temperature Comparison')
plt.xlabel('Day')
plt.ylabel('Temperature')
plt.legend()
plt.savefig('temp.png')
plt.show()
items.markingKey: 5 marks: import and data 1, two plot() calls with styles and labels 2, title and axis labels 1, legend and savefig 1.

items.stem: The sales (₹) of a Stationery shop and a Bakery shop in Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr are [67000, 34000, 83000, 88000] and [72000, 51000, 21000, 40000]. Write a program to store them in a DataFrame with columns Period, Stationery and Bakery, plot a line chart of both shops against Period directly from the DataFrame with a title and axis labels, and save it as sales.png.
items.answer:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
df = pd.DataFrame({'Period': ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr'], 'Stationery': [67000, 34000, 83000, 88000], 'Bakery': [72000, 51000, 21000, 40000]})
df.plot(kind='line', x='Period', title='Sales Comparison')
plt.xlabel('Period')
plt.ylabel('Sales (Rs)')
plt.savefig('sales.png')
plt.show()
items.markingKey: 3 marks: DataFrame 1, df.plot() with kind and x 1, labels/title and savefig 1.
